messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: 'tkrplot' package error stops shiny from deploying on shinyapps.io
parts:
Unfortunately you can't deploy shiny applications that rely on any packages that need access to the display (such as Tk).  These applications cannot be hosted on Shiny Server, Shiny Server Pro, and shinyapps.io  The idea is that shiny applications render themselves within a browser, while Tk presumes that it has access to the graphics display itself which of course on a server, would run on the server, and not within the client's browser.  

Ann, the issue you are seeing is probably related to a package that you are using within your application which relies on the tkrplot package being installed.  

Hope this helps.
